HERO.title: Hi, I'm David Uribe
HERO.description: Frontend & Full Stack Developer specialized in business applications and management systems. I have developed and commercialized solutions for sales, customer management, and business operations using React, Astro, TypeScript, Firebase, and performance-oriented scalable architectures. My experience includes CRM platforms for sales teams, operational management systems, and applications with advanced caching strategies designed to reduce database queries and improve user experience.

ABOUT.p1: I am a Frontend & Full Stack Developer specialized in business applications and management platforms.
ABOUT.p2: Over the last few years, I have participated in the design and development of systems for sales operations, customer management, business processes, and administrative control, primarily working with React, TypeScript, Astro, and Firebase.
ABOUT.p3: Beyond building modern user interfaces, I focus on performance and scalability by implementing caching strategies, data version control, and query optimization techniques that reduce operational costs and improve user experience. I also collaborate directly with clients to define requirements, design workflows, and transform business needs into functional digital products.
